test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Earlier I use to knit very fast, but due to old age my fingers are not so __nimble__.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Agile.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Nimble" means being able to move quickly and lightly. **(फुरतीला)

 
 
• Example: For a large man he is quite nimble on his feet.
 
 
 
 
 
• Synonym of 'n
